input.prompt: A 360 degree panoramic view from human eye level inside this peaceful solarpunk orbital garden. Preserve the forward view's carved cream limestone reading pavilion, warm walnut shelves, bronze architectural details, rooted mature trees, planted beds, broad connected stone paths, water garden, glass observatory and distant giant planet. Extend a coherent continuous garden all around the camera with an open walking area in the foreground. All architecture stands on connected ground. Warm architectural lighting and cool celestial ambient light. No people, no robots, no text, no signs, no UI.
